latest_release.name: v1.8.1 - Windows
latest_release.body:
#### What's new
Microsoft and IAMAI collaborated to advance high-fidelity autonomy simulations through Project AirSim—the evolution of AirSim— released under the MIT license as part of a DARPA-supported initiative.  IAMAI is proud to have contributed to these efforts and has published its version of the Project AirSim repository at [github.com/iamaisim/ProjectAirSim](https://github.com/iamaisim/ProjectAirSim).

#### Environments
There are the following environments available:

1. AbandonedPark 
1. Africa (uneven terrain and animated animals)
1. AirSimNH  (small urban neighborhood block)
1. Blocks
1. Building_99
1. CityEnviron
1. Coastline
1. LandscapeMountains 
1. MSBuild2018 (soccer field)
1. TrapCamera
1. ZhangJiajie

Download the zip file for the environment you want, extract it somewhere, and run the run.bat. Please see [docs](https://microsoft.github.io/AirSim/use_precompiled/) for how to use the car or drone model.

#### Downloading large environments
CityEnviron, Coastline, and TrapCamera are big environments, so they are divided into multiple files.  After downloading the 001, 002, and 003 files, please use software such as [7zip](http://www.7-zip.org/download.html) to right-click on 001 file and chose one of the extract options. The 7zip automatically will detect and use all files.

#### Slow / unreliable Internet connection?
Try [uMap download manager](http://ugetdm.com/). This allows resume and multiple connections to speed things up.

## Note about availability of source code of environments
The environments available in release binaries make use of proprietary assets which prevents us from distributing the source code and project files of these environments. Some of these environments can be purchased on the [Unreal Engine Marketplace](https://unrealengine.com/marketplace/en-US/store).
